# Prism
**中文文档：README.zh-CN.md**

**An MCP server for design work.** Give an AI agent the ability to generate design
tokens, assemble

a page from 38 component types, review it for accessibility and
design quality, and export it as cod

38 component types, review it for accessibility and
design quality, and export it as code or tokens.

- **42 tools**, 4 resources, 3 prompts over **stdio**
- **38 component types** with validated Zod pr

op schemas
- **Export** to HTML, React, Vue, React-TS, Svelte, CSS, presentation, Flutter, SwiftUI
-
**Tokens** in DTCG, CSS custom properties, Style Dictionary, Figma Tokens, Tailwind v4 `@theme`, DE

SIGN.md
- **Sessions** are stateful and persisted: save/load a project as `.prism.json`
- **Live pre
view**: one stable artifact any viewer can follow (`design_preview_sync`), plus a self-contained Dee
pSeek Harness plugin (`dsh-plugin-prism-design`) whose panel opens from the sidebar rail or the righ

t Sidebar
- **No dashboard, no HTTP server, no external APIs.** Exported pages are self-contained (p
ure CSS animation, no CDN runtime)

### Wire it into an MCP client
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Any MCP-capable client works (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code, or your own).
Once connected, ask
the agent for something like:

> Build a landing page for a coffee roastery, warm and editorial. Then audit it
> for accessibility
and export the React version.

The agent will call `design_init` → `design_add_component` → `design_audit_accessibility`
→ `design_
export` and can inspect its own work through `design_get_state`.

| Tool | What it does |

| `ui_generate_color_palette` | Harmonious palettes from a base colour (6 harmony schemes) |
| `ui_s

uggest_typography` | Curated font pairings with Google Fonts links |
| `ui_generate_type_scale` | Mo

dular type scales (golden ratio, perfect fourth, …) |
| `ui_generate_spacing_scale` | Spacing system

s (linear, geometric, fibonacci) |
| `ui_generate_shadow_system` | Elevation shadow sets (subtle, me

dium, sharp) |
| `ui_generate_border_radius_scale` | Radius scales (sharp, subtle, rounded, pill) |

| `ui_check_color_contrast` | WCAG 2.1 contrast ratios with AA/AAA grading |
| `ui_generate_gradient

` | CSS gradients with harmonious stops |
| `ui_suggest_breakpoints` | Responsive breakpoint systems

(Tailwind, Bootstrap, Material) |
| `ui_generate_design_tokens` | A complete token system in one ca

ilwind, Bootstrap, Material) |
| `ui_generate_design_tokens` | A complete token system in one call |
### Session — build a design in the server's state (18 + 3 persistence)
| Tool | What it does |

| `design_init` | Start a session (neutral default tokens + optional base colour) |
| `design_add_co

mponent` | Add a component by type, with validated props |
| `design_update_component` | Update prop

s, layout, visibility, lock |
| `design_rename_component` | Rename a layer |
| `design_remove_compon

ent` | Remove a component |
| `design_reorder_component` | Reorder siblings |
| `design_align_compon

ents` | Align/distribute (single undo step) |
| `design_z_order_component` | Stacking: front/back/fo

rward/backward |
| `design_set_token` | Set one token |
| `design_set_theme` | Light/dark |
| `desig

n_apply_template` | One of 5 page templates |
| `design_add_page` / `design_switch_page` / `design_r

emove_page` | Multi-page sessions |
| `design_get_state` | Read the whole session (tokens, pages, co

mponents, activity) |
| `design_get_conflicts` | Token contrast conflicts |
| `design_undo` / `desig

n_redo` | History (50 snapshots) |

ojects` | Persist and restore a session as `.prism.json` |
### Review, delivery and meta (11)
| Tool | What it does |

| `design_audit_accessibility` | WCAG-oriented audit with a 0–100 score |
| `design_suggest_improvem

ents` | Heuristic review: structure, density, motion, a11y, tokens |
| `design_render_preview` | Sta

ndalone HTML preview (PNG when Playwright is installed) |
| `design_preview_sync` | Write the live-p

review file so a watching viewer shows the latest design |
| `design_export` | html / react / vue /

react-ts / svelte / css / presentation / flutter / swiftui |
| `design_export_tokens` | DTCG / CSS /

Style Dictionary / Figma Tokens / DESIGN.md / Tailwind v4 |
| `design_import_tokens` | Import DTCG

tokens (replace / merge-overwrite / merge-keep) |
| `design_import_webpage` | Import a URL or pasted

HTML as components |
| `design_import_design_md` | Import tokens from a Google DESIGN.md document |

| `design_semantic_style` | Map adjectives ("warm", "温暖") onto measurable token deltas |

list_capabilities` | The manifest |
### Resources and prompts

- Resources: `prism://tokens/active`, `prism://components/registry`,
`prism://patterns`, `prism://au

dit/checklist`
- Prompts: `build_page`, `design_review`, `import_project`
### Live preview

`design_preview_sync` renders the current page to one stable file
(`PRISM_PREVIEW_FILE`, default `<c

wd>/.prism-preview/design.html`), stamped with
a revision. Because it is a single path that is overw

ritten in place, any watcher
can follow it — see DeepSeek Harness integration, whose
[该节后续省略]
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]

One mutation path: every tool calls `design-service`, which calls
`DesignStateStore`. Undo/redo, act

ivity logging, conflict detection and the
export pipeline all hang off that single store, so no two

tools can disagree
about state. This is enforced: `tests/mutation-path.test.ts` fails if a tool
reac

hes past the service to a store mutator, which is what keeps the component
type allowlist, the prop
schemas and the token-category check from being bypassed.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The geometry layer (a layout engine, a tidy-up pass, and an auto-layout pass) was
removed: exports a

re CSS flow layout and never read `layout` coordinates, so
nothing consumed it.
